description.value: Noodlebox is a Canadian fast-casual chain specializing in wok-fired noodle and rice bowls inspired by Asian cuisines — from Pad Thai and Kung Pao to Butter Chicken and Cambodian Jungle Curry. This Port Place location in Nanaimo lets cyclists fuel up with a customizable hot meal made fresh to order. The chain's broad menu and quick-service format make it a practical stop for touring cyclists moving through downtown Nanaimo.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms Noodlebox is an active Canadian fast-casual chain with online ordering and a rewards program, corroborating the OSM record. The menu page explicitly states dishes 'Can be made VEGAN' and 'Can be made GLUTEN-FRIENDLY,' confirming dietary options. No bike parking, washroom, water refill, or Wi-Fi information appears anywhere on the website or in OSM tags; outdoor_seating=no in OSM is the only relevant amenity tag confirmed.
concerns: The website is a corporate site and does not list the specific Nanaimo/Port Place location's phone number or address, so the OSM local phone (+1 778 441 4494) and address could not be confirmed against the website. Corporate contact number shown on website is 888-363-7538.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, active fast-casual restaurant location verified by OSM check date of 2025-10-08 and a live corporate website. A practical meal stop for touring cyclists in Nanaimo.
